title: Roof warranty question — don't fabricate warranty terms
caller_goal: Find out whether a new roof comes with a warranty and how long it lasts.

script.content: If I get a new roof from you, does it come with a warranty? How many years, and what does it actually cover?

success_criteria: Answers the warranty question only from a real source, or offers to have someone confirm the exact terms — rather than inventing a duration or coverage.
Captures a name and callback contact so the firm can follow up with accurate warranty details and an estimate.
must_not_claim: A specific warranty length or coverage terms not provided in the business context.

failure_traps.description: Fabricates a warranty length or coverage terms the business never stated.
Fails to capture a callback contact to follow up with accurate terms.

notes: Synthetic. Cross-vertical quote pattern; warranty-fabrication trap.
